semantics.retrieval_text: LSP Position Encoding Normalization. PX normalizes LSP positions across UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32 code-unit conventions so semantic ranges map deterministically to source byte/string offsets without corrupting non-ASCII text. LSP positions are encoding-dependent and cannot be treated as raw Python/string indexes. Offset-to-position and position-to-offset conversions must round-trip under the negotiated encoding. Invalid lines/characters or split code points must fail rather than silently shifting an edit or diagnostic.
